'''Bogg 5''', or '''Bogg V''', was one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] transported [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] to Bogg 5, where he surrendered the captive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].
